description: One public action (a protest, a strike, a hearing packed, a blockade), posted to the repo of someone who was there or is organizing it. Public and permanent: only what the organizers already made public belongs here.

title.description: What it is, in a few words.

date.description: The calendar day it happens or happened where it happens, YYYY-MM-DD. No time and no zone: the link carries details.

crowd.description: A rough size: dozens, hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands. Never a count.

link.description: The organizers' own announcement, or a report of the action.

area.description: Where, as an area, never an address.

geohash.description: A five-character geohash: a cell about 5 km across.

name.description: A town or neighbourhood, as people there say it.
